_comment: Copy to agents.json and edit. Each agent is backed by the Codex CLI (your ChatGPT subscription). 'main' is the one you chat with on Telegram; others collaborate via inter-agent messages.
_model: Optional per-agent 'model' field: the Codex model that agent runs on. Omit for the Codex default. It is written to agents/<name>/.model, the single source of truth -- change it later with: bin/ctl.sh model <agent> <model|default>.

agents.name: main
agents.role: Fő asszisztens, veled beszél Telegramon és koordinálja a többit.

agents.name: coder
agents.role: Fejlesztő: kód írása, javítás, kis scriptek.
